    Word lists¶

    These lists are generated automatically from the project's lexicon (4250 entries). Words are grouped by semantic domain following the SIL Semantic Domains classification; a word may appear in several domains. Attested words link to their first occurrence in the Kisiei Bible; Confirmed words are not in the Bible but confirmed by a speaker; Respelled words come from the 1979 description and still need confirmation; Southern Kissi words are known only from the Southern Kissi dictionary (Childs 2000): they are not attested in the North and are spelled as Childs writes them. The lexicon is also available as CSV, TSV, LIFT (for FieldWorks) and CLDF.

    1. Universe, creation¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    cɔvɔɔ verb make; create Gen 2:1

    1.1 Sky¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    còó noun (o) — Southern Kissi only sky, weather; the art of climbing palm trees
    halaa noun sky — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : cloud, sky, heavens; also the name of a spirit Keita 1979, p. 154
    halataalaa noun (o) sky; heaven Gen 1
    yálábóndáá noun (o) — Southern Kissi only frog species; rainbow

    1.1.1 Sun¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    loei, pl. loeon noun (i) star Num 24:17
    mɔmtombolaa noun Pleiades (constellation) Job 9:9
    paale kalalen noun noon, midday sun Keita 1979, p. 154
    paalen noun (len) sun; day — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : day, sun; midday, noon, afternoon Gen 1:14
    paangei noun (i) moon — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : moon, month; menstrual period Gen 1:16
    ŋama-ŋama ideophone (ideophone) in full (of the sun: high, in full strength) Gen 29:7

    1.1.2 Air¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    fú-fú ideophone — Southern Kissi only sound of rushing air (brushing branches, rubbing cloth)
    hoeiye noun (i) cold; breath, wind; malaria, flu ; air, wind; cold; breath — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : cold, cold wind; cold dry season; fever Gen 7:22
    hoeyii noun (i) wind; breath — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : cold wind, cold season; fever Gen 2:7
    hullo verb blow (on); breathe into — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : blow on something; also lie to someone Job 4:15
    hɔŋndo verb blow; sound (a trumpet) Exod 10:13
    ɲɛ̀fɛ̀fɛ̀lló noun (o) — Southern Kissi only cool, gentle breeze in the heat of the day

    1.1.3 Weather¶

    Kisiei Category English Source
    cálá-cálá ideophone — Southern Kissi only heavy rain, water pouring over
    còó noun (o) — Southern Kissi only sky, weather; the art of climbing palm trees
    cɔ́lɔ̀ɔ̀-cɔ́lɔ̀ɔ̀ ideophone — Southern Kissi only sound of heavy rain or water pouring
    cɛɛluu verb bring down, fell; drip, fall (dew) Num 21:30

    lelan conjunction therefore, so Gen 2:24
    lende adverb thus, so, in this way, like that Gen 1:7
    mi conjunction and (then); so that — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : also 'that' (subordinating) Gen 1:1
    nduyɛ conjunction however, indeed — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : and then Gen 9:4
    niko adverb then, now; (after an imperative) please, do — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : now, right away, right then Gen 3:17
    o kon kɔɔli adverb after that, then, afterwards — Southern Kissi (Childs 2000) : in addition, moreover, besides
    pɛɛn particle namely, that is (appositive particle) Gen 4:2
    sisa adverb now, now then (lelan sisa) Gen 24:49
    sɛ́lɛ̀lɛ́ adverb — Southern Kissi only indeed, verily, really
    taama-taama adverb especially, above all Gen 31:18
